patch_description: This implementation replaces moving averages with an innovation-gated adaptive Kalman trend tracker. Instead of averaging an entire window and introducing substantial delay, it maintains a causal position/velocity state and dynamically adjusts process noise according to recent innovations. Large, sustained innovations increase responsiveness during genuine trend changes, while isolated outliers are clipped and treated as noise. A robust residual scale estimate drives measurement-noise adaptation, reducing false reversals in volatile regions without suppressing legitimate motion. The returned samples retain the original trailing-window output alignment and length.
